name: Silvern ~Gin no Tsuki, Mayoi no Mori~
source:
Main character admires manly men, because he is often taken for a slender a cute girl. He gets a job of female dormitory caretaker for a week by mistake. How will this week go?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公崇拜充满男子气概的男人，因为身材纤细、长相可爱的他总被误认成女孩。一次阴差阳错之下，他得到了一份为期一周的女生宿舍管理员工作。这一周将会如何度过？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
